note: The coverage rule, held in one place: check-constraints.py --coverage reads this file. A move's constraints file maps every defect below either to the ids of hard constraints whose `source` is the sha256 of a verified source (match exact or normalised, in docs/anim/sources/ or this plugin's skills/_shared/sources/), or to {"not_applicable": "<reason>"}. A defect whose `required_when` holds cannot be not_applicable. Anything else refuses the spec.

defects.what: A held weapon, a closed fist or a shield beats against the body during locomotion instead of riding with the torso.
defects.hint: Speed or peak-to-peak displacement of the hands, pommel and tip in the chest's frame, on the locomotion clips.

defects.what: A cut whose tip travels along its own blade axis, driven by the wrist rather than the shoulder: it reads as a stab.
defects.hint: Tip velocity against the blade axis (velocity_axis_angle), arm extension at contact, the shoulder leading the hand, the line the source draws.

defects.what: A weapon hand that reads as the other hand: the forearm turned past its range, the hand mirrored, or the fingers closed on the wrong side of the grip.
defects.hint: handedness on the weapon hand, the grip checks (palm_distance, fingers_wrap, index_toward_blade), forearm rotation against the anatomy table.
